**About the Team:**
Qualcomm’s Applied ML R&D for HW Design team develops ML/AI or algorithmic based design tools which improve the overall chip design process and quality through NRE and/or AuC reduction or performance improvement. We are an interdisciplinary team with backgrounds in Computer Science, ML/AI, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Physics, Neuroscience, Economics, and VLSI Design, united by our passion to solve challenging problems. We are seeking a candidate who can provide technical execution and leadership in Machine Learning/AI R&D including Generative AI and its applications in chip design. The candidate will serve as a technical contributor and lead to an interdisciplinary team of ML researchers, ML SW engineers, and HW designers. * Engages with cross-functional teams to identify and deliver solutions for technical gaps and opportunities.
* Contributes to the team’s innovation engine from idea to execution.
* Develops effective working relationships with cross-functional and/or external stakeholders.

* Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Java, or C++.
* Experience with machine learning frameworks and libraries (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn).
* Hands-on industry expertise in Agentic AI tools, frameworks, and best practices (e.g. Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, Langchain, Langchain, Agno).

* Strong communication skills and ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.

Internal Infrastructure builds the infrastructure and tools used to train, evaluate, and serve Cohere's foundation models. You will work with AI researchers and ML engineers on stability, scalability, and observability. The work accelerates the models behind Cohere's platform, North.

 - Work with the data infrastructure team on storage for checkpoints and other training artifacts.

 - Troubleshoot production failures and performance problems, and leave the system easier to operate than you found it.

 - Run a job platform, batch system, or Kubernetes controllers in production. Scheduling, queues, and multi-tenant fairness are central to this work.

 - Written software in Python or Go. You would rather extend a solid open-source project than rebuild it.

 - Found a bottleneck, proposed a fix, and driven it in a fast-moving environment.

 We are seeking a talented Gen AI engineer with a passion for creating and maintaining AI agents and generative features in our applications.  Your work will enable our client users to work more efficiently and promote more relationships being created and becoming successful and better performing in our partnerships marketplace.

* Work with the squad’s full stack engineer to expose new features in the user interface, and deploy the agent or point content generation capabilities throughout our apps.
* Work closely with product managers to identify new features and enhancements, estimate level of effort, prototype, implement and deploy.

* Stay up\-to\-date with the latest advancements in AI and machine learning, and continuously explore new techniques and technologies to enhance our product offerings.

* Technical Expertise:
* Understanding of LLM/GPT concepts
* Proficiency in prompt engineering.
* Proficiency with Python
* Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Looker) and/or sql query writing.
